sources.notes: ‘最大技术突破’需要比较反应式 VLA、分层规划、世界模型后果预演、4D/几何动态、触觉纠错与闭环评测路线，并为每条路线检索反证。

queries.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-planning
queries.query: (all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA) AND (all:"world model" OR all:"world action model") AND (all:planning OR all:foresight OR all:rollout)
queries.why: 捕捉从直接动作预测转向动作条件后果预演的核心路线。

queries.label: dynamic-structured-hierarchical-vla
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"robot policy") AND (all:structured OR all:hierarchical OR all:symbolic) AND (all:planning OR all:"world model")
queries.why: 检索结构化里程碑、分层世界模型与长时程任务—运动规划。

queries.label: dynamic-geometry-dynamics-vla
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:4D OR all:geometry OR all:pointmap OR all:"point track") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
queries.why: 检索用 4D/几何动态给 VLA 提供可执行物理表征的路线。

queries.label: dynamic-vla-correction-recovery
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:recovery OR all:correction OR all:"self-correct" OR all:failure)
queries.why: 检索失败检测、接触纠错、自我恢复和后训练。

queries.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-limits
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:failure OR all:drift OR all:attack OR all:admissibility OR all:benchmark)
queries.why: 主动检索世界模型路线的失效、攻击、可采信性与闭环评测反证。

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-vla-breakthrough-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org VLA world model structured planning robot manipulation 2026
browser_fallback_queries.why: 官方 API 漏检时补充新方法名称。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-vla-breakthrough-web
web_calibration_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs/2607 VLA robot world model planning
web_calibration_queries.why: 校准 2026 年 7 月最新术语。
